system.description:
Where you lay your hands, torn flesh knits and broken bodies are made whole; this is the healing gift for which the Salubri were revered.

Touch an area on or near the injury; if the subject is unwilling this may require a Physical Challenge, retested with Medicine. Each Blood Trait you expend immediately and completely heals one health level of lethal damage, while aggravated damage costs two Blood Traits per level. If your generation prevents you from spending enough blood at once, you may maintain contact over several turns to mend severe injuries, and you may heal as much or as little as you choose.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
